target: Complete the signed and target-encrypted project-evidence-v1 cloud path.
primary_semantics: Use explicit project-evidence envelope kinds and the common transport sha256 field without weakening archive or Environment stream binding.
invariants: Raw conversations, summaries, indexes, Environment records, and project evidence package bytes remain unchanged.
Archive, Environment, and project-evidence envelopes cannot be opened as one another.
Only trusted target nodes receive signed and encrypted project evidence bundles.
The legacy bundle_sha256 export field remains available as a compatibility alias.
allowed_changes: Add explicit project-evidence envelope kinds, normalize export hash fields, add focused tests, update documentation, defect evidence, and release metadata.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite archives or evidence packages, reuse another stream kind, relax identity or target checks, change trust, or bypass encryption.
before_after_checks: The native helper advertises project-evidence-v1-bundle and project-evidence-v1-ack.
A project evidence envelope round-trips only with its exact stream kind.
Exported sha256 and bundle_sha256 both equal the actual bundle bytes.
The authorized Windows-to-Mac production outbox publishes events 1 through 8 without quarantine or transient failure.

original_triggers: The project evidence exporter returned bundle_sha256 while the common cloud transport required sha256.
The native envelope helper rejected the declared project-evidence-v1 bundle kind.
